subject: SORT statement
notes: kb/Work PB1177 (w1084f, review finding R1-1). Rule: 'If a USE procedure invoked while a format 1 SORT statement is active does not complete normally, the SORT statement is terminated.' (cite.py --check 14.9.40.4 OK, GR17). ONE run-time mechanism for EVERY USE procedure invoked while the SORT is active, whichever runtime element declares it (GR10/GR13 put the statements of a CALLed program or INVOKEd method, and the USE procedures they invoke, in the procedure's range; a containing program's GLOBAL declarative, 14.9.49.4 GR4 b), likewise): every format 1 SORT registers itself as the run unit's active format 1 SORT first in its body (CobolSort.RegisterFormat1Sort, with its scope's __useActive or null; EcEmitter.SortUseScope), the generated __RunUse of every EC-model element hands every DECLARATIVE's action to CobolSort.AfterUseProcedure, which throws SortTerminationSignal for the innermost active format 1 SORT (SortFileTable.ActiveFormat1Sort) on a completion that is not normal (DispatchResult.CompletedNotNormally: RESUME of either form, or the NotNormal fall-off of 14.6.13.1.2 1)), and SortEmitter.TerminationLanding's catch ends the statement after its finally. An EXIT PROGRAM or GOBACK in another element's USE procedure is noted by a declining filter (CobolSort.UseProcedureExited) and terminates the SORT once that activation has returned (SortFileTable.AfterActivationReturn, asked by CallEmitter.EmitActivationReturned at every CALL, function-activation and INVOKE site once 14.9.23.4 GR8 has placed the result and the GOBACK RAISING pickup has run, and by ProgramTable.CallFromHost at the host boundary - review finding R2-1: asked in the method epilogue it unwound past the RETURNING delivery; kb/Work PB3246: the pickup comes first, so a condition the same USE procedure staged with GOBACK RAISING is raised in the activator before the SORT ends, 14.9.18.4 GR1 b), witnessed by conformance:cases/14.9.40-SORT/pb3246_sort_terminated_after_raising_pickup). Determination (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3): GR17 is the rule 14.9.33.4 GR2 a) yields to, so RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT and a not-normal fall-off land after the SORT; the SORT's own RESUME AT procedure-name is a GO TO taken after the SORT has ended (GR3), another element's is not taken (its activation ended with the range); activations the range entered keep their BY REFERENCE stores (14.2.3 GR8) and an INITIAL program's implicit CANCEL (14.9.18.4 GR2). MERGE registers nothing (its rules, 14.9.24.4, carry no such sentence). Witnesses: conformance:cases/14.9.40-SORT/pb1177_sort_procedure_use_not_normal (the SORT's own procedures, eight legs), conformance:cases/14.9.40-SORT/pb1177_sort_called_use_not_normal (a CALLed program: control, RESUME NEXT, RESUME AT, output procedure, GOBACK, an INITIAL program twice, the container's GLOBAL declarative for a SORT with no declaratives), conformance:cases/14.9.40-SORT/pb1177_invoke_sort_use_not_normal (an INVOKEd method: control, RESUME NEXT, GOBACK), conformance:cases/14.9.40-SORT/pb1177_sort_called_goback_ec_free (the GOBACK arm in an EC-free group, 2002 and later), conformance:cases/14.6.13.1.2-Normal-completion-of-a-declarative-procedure/pb367b_sort_use_not_normal (the implicit-transfer arm), conformance:cases/14.9.40-SORT/pb1177_method_sort_use_not_normal (a SORT in a method), unit:SortUseTerminationTests.OwnDeclarative_NotNormal_TerminatesTheSortWithItsAction, unit:SortUseTerminationTests.AnotherElementsDeclarative_NotNormal_TerminatesTheSortAtItsEnd, unit:SortUseTerminationTests.NormalCompletion_ReturnsTheAction, unit:SortUseTerminationTests.EndedSortsAndMerges_AreNotTerminated, unit:SortUseTerminationTests.ExitFromAUseProcedure_TerminatesAnotherElementsSortAtTheActivationsReturn, unit:SortUseTerminationTests.NestedSorts_TheInnermostIsTerminated (the run-time protocol: the SORT's own and another element's declarative, normal completion, ended SORTs and MERGEs, the EXIT/GOBACK arm, nested SORTs).
